$comment: The languages passioncode.ai is published in (docs/DEPLOYMENT.md#languages). English is the source: its pages are written by hand at /, every other language is generated under /<code>/ from the catalogs in i18n/<code>/. Adding a language is one entry here (latinSpacing: false writes Latin names against CJK text without a space, as Japanese does; attachParticles: true drops the space before a Korean particle that follows a link or code span) plus its catalogs; `npm run locales -- --missing` lists what to translate. name: the language's own name, shown in the language switch. englishName: what the commercial mailbox reads. og: the Open Graph locale. intl: the BCP 47 tag for numbers, money and plural rules. switchLabel: the language switch's accessible name, in the language itself.
